propositions: Merge-abort recovery logic for the tickets branch is duplicated across sync.reconverge and push_recovery, with separate implementations of the quarantine mover and abort-message parser

The two mover implementations have drifted: push_recovery._quarantine_untracked_paths validates untracked status via git before moving, while sync._quarantine_untracked lacks this fence, causing identical bugs to land in both paths separately
A third caller (doctor.py::_quarantine_leftovers) uses sync's mover directly, creating a three-way maintenance burden and inconsistent behavior
The consolidation must accept git as a callable parameter to accommodate both the sync module-level _git and the late-bound core._git seam without losing either side's patch points
Pinning tests across ten existing test suites must pass with zero assertion edits after the consolidation
